title: Large Language Models Portray Socially Subordinate Groups as More Homogeneous, Consistent with a Bias Observed in Humans

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting ChatGPT to generate short texts (e.g., stories, biographies) about intersectional identities including different racial and ethnic groups (African, Asian, Hispanic, and White Americans), and measuring the homogeneity of the generated narratives by calculating the pairwise cosine similarity of their sentence embeddings.

Prompting ChatGPT to generate short texts about men and women, and measuring how homogeneously the model portrays these gender groups by evaluating the pairwise cosine similarity of sentence embeddings from the generated outputs.
